The left arm carries the native small elongated dark bronze kite shield with brass studded rim. Two large feathered wings extend from the upper back, pale silvery lavender upper feathers and deep navy-violet undersides, layered long flight feathers and bright pale upper leading edges. Preserve exact wing spread, folds, occlusion, feather direction and native asymmetry in every pose. Preserve the original dark tonal weight, long legs, tan skin, green skirt, dark armor and restrained metallic highlights. No halo, glow, invented jewelry, cape, extra weapons, symbols or costume redesign. Native skirt palette variants will be derived offline; keep wings, skin, armor, leather, gold and cloth material boundaries clear.
